courses.title: Categorical and derived tools for analytic sheaves
courses.description: Universal properties and category theory; Ind and Pro constructions; monoidal categories and duality; modules, stacks and coherent descent; complexes, triangulated categories and derived functors; sheaf cohomology, local-to-global comparisons and gerbes. Completed tensor adjoints and their finite-dimensional criterion are included.
courses.coverage_note: 237 lessons with 948 fully worked exercises. Each result has the hypotheses and prerequisites stated in its lesson.
prerequisites: Categories, sheaves, sites and module tensor products
